method: Declared resource schedules and mechanical stress, not measured human win rates

limits: Economic inventory stress, not a geometric flight controller or measured human win rate.
Reaction figures label correction/miss scenarios; no reaction-delayed physics controller is claimed.

Pickup contacts, bad-packet avoidance, correction taps and imposed collisions are stochastic assumptions. Dark Seeds reduce visibility in play; their secondary targeting effect is represented by the miss sensitivity, not simulated as a separate fuel penalty.
Conditional-clear scenarios isolate economy even if fuel stress flags occur; attrition scenarios end failed attempts and lose their income.
Real production map graph, pickups, prices, modifiers, rewards, banking, conversion fractions and spending are used.
Uses actual node row and duration with a deterministic cached inventory per level/route/phase; does not enumerate every layout seed.
No TEST purchasing. Default campaigns start Vitality; startingOnly compares all three roots with shared streams.
Spending policies buy single-companion/main/conversion skills and sockets; paid extra lives and additional companion slots are excluded to isolate role balance.

Actual ArtifactEffects handles charges, seed chains and free-Lift caps; work/reveal/recharge opportunities remain scenario approximations. Black Hole exposure is an assumed straight pass at 85/140/195 clearance.
Tree fraction uses all nominal main/selected-companion/conversion ranks, including mutually exclusive paths; it is not a claim about fully purchasable completion.

Night Gardener skim fuel and passive vision influence on missed pickups not modeled. Black-hole exposure uses actual drain falloff along one scheduled straight 154-unit/s passage, sampled at half-second intervals; not geometric steering.

controller.visibility: Within 2.1 current light radii and viewport; conservative obstacle slices; not a perceptual human model.
limitations: Conservative square-expanded terrain slices guide prediction; real circle collisions run in engine.
Bot model approximates Leveler and localized gust trajectories.
No future Power activations planned; controller uses role-aware heuristics.
No human or mobile-performance inference from bot success.
controller.cheats: None. No warp, refill, collision immunity, pickup removal, or engine runtime edits.
